name: claude-bridge-dev
description: PRE-RELEASE (development channel) of claude-bridge — multi-chat orchestration for Claude Code. Same features as the stable channel plus whatever is being prepared for the next release; not yet proven in operation. For production use install `claude-bridge` instead. Do not install both at once — they would run two MCP servers side by side. File-based inbox, peer messaging, peer_chat_read, peer_chat_search, enhanced list_sessions, context-usage monitoring (peer_context_status + wake-time guard), idle-beep notification, bundled role skills, and an opt-in control-plane daemon for peer lifecycle (spawn/stop/restart/compact) + team_layout + subscriber delivery — see docs/SETUP-DAEMON.md and ADR-008.
